name: Fragments UI
summary: Accessible React components on Base UI for AI agents, with CLI/MCP governance.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 50+ documented primitives — not full inventory.
Fragments Cloud governance product is invite-only; UI kit itself is free MIT on npm/CLI.
Optional peers (recharts, react-day-picker, etc.) needed only for advanced comps — excluded here.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Accessible action button with variants and tones.

demo.peerNotes: Requires react + react-dom; import @usefragments/ui/styles once for tokens

components.copyCode:
npx @usefragments/cli add button
# or: npm install @usefragments/ui

import { Button } from "@usefragments/ui"
import "@usefragments/ui/styles"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use Fragments UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.usefragments.com/components/button. Install with `npx @usefragments/cli add button` or `npm install @usefragments/ui`, then `import { Button } from "@usefragments/ui"` and `import "@usefragments/ui/styles"`. Docs/install: https://www.usefragments.com/components/install. Home: https://www.usefragments.com. Repo: https://github.com/fragments-sdk/ui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fragments-sdk/ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2024-present Conan McNicholl). Pricing free. npm: @usefragments/ui.
